"Tap to give all vampires +1 stealth on hunt actions until your next
untap phase."

permanently at an additional +1 stealth?

I'd say yes.
The card doesn't say "Whilst tapped, vampires get +1 stealth to hunt",
it merely sets a game condition which is not dependant upon the card.
Same would go for if the Sunset Strip was burned via Arson, Rampage
etc.
